class.name: Pixal3DLatent
class.brief_description: Intermediate handle passed from [method Pixal3DPipeline.encode_image] to [method Pixal3DPipeline.decode_latent].
class.description: Carries whatever the pipeline hands over between the image-encoder half and the mesh-decoder half. The current trellis2 C ABI runs image to mesh in one call, so this class stashes the image bytes plus a snapshot of the generation options; when the ABI grows explicit intermediate entry points, the same handle holds the sparse-structure or shape-SLAT latent instead, without any caller change.

method.name: get_image_bytes
method.description: Returns the image bytes handed to [method Pixal3DPipeline.encode_image]. Empty until the ABI split lands and the handle carries a real latent instead.

method.name: get_options_snapshot
method.description: Returns the encode-time options snapshot. [method Pixal3DPipeline.decode_latent] merges its own [code skip-lint]gen_opts[/code] over this snapshot so a decode may override, but not repeat, what encode already chose.
